people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Rahab
people.line: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho

translations.web: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”
translations.bsb: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab and said, “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.”
translations.kjv: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
translations.asv: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, that are entered into thy house; for they are come to search out all the land.
